sourceFacts.fact: Unconjugated bilirubin circulates largely bound to albumin.
The unbound fraction can enter the brain and is relevant to neurotoxicity risk.

layout: Two equal upper comparison cards. LEFT card1 shows a large teal rectangle labelled Albumin with a small ochre bilirubin coin visibly attached by a clasp. RIGHT card2 shows the same ochre bilirubin coin separate from any albumin. Under right card only, two arrows continue down through card3 then4. Left card has no downward route. Footer: The free fraction matters; this is not a brain-barrier drawing. Do not draw brain, membrane, cells, blood vessel or anatomical barrier. Do not show albumin crossing any line. Add a small label Unconjugated bilirubin above the pair.
